methodology.browser: Headed Chromium, same ANGLE Metal Apple M3 Pro setup as earlier review
methodology.settings: Fresh localStorage on each navigation, supplied save preserved except kaijuSpawns=false, Max frame cap, toolbar collapsed
methodology.startupServer: Fresh production build through Vite preview
methodology.interactions: 100 sinusoidal pointer moves, >=15 ms wait between moves; zone painting four real clicks >=600 ms apart; full elapsed frame counts, wrapping scene.pick and pointer callbacks
methodology.confirmation: Two additional road-preview runs; frame windows 3.5 s while pointer workload continues, pick statistics cover all 100 moves
methodology.display: Two rounds, fresh page per configuration, 1.8 s warmup then full 3.5 s frame window; screenshots inspected for street and retina framing
methodology.memory: Explicit CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage before Runtime.getHeapUsage; in-page named loads explicitly select Review and assert 1287 buildings
methodology.soak: Five actual road-create/bulldoze/restore cycles, then three one-minute x4 windows, forced GC between windows excluded from frame statistics, then pause 2.5 s to allow save timer
methodology.loading: Two cleared-cache loads, one reload after warming same page, one cleared-cache 10 Mbit/s/40 ms network +4x CPU-throttled desktop load. Ready: 28 models and 1287 buildings. First WebGL draw is not complete readiness.
limitations: No real mobile device, GPU-memory-byte accounting, hour-long soak or repeated extended combat session.
Display configurations differ in aspect ratio as well as pixels.
Single-run long-window maxima are observations, not stable percentiles across sessions.
Runtime wrappers add overhead; method upload duration excludes matrix preparation.
